body.statement: The sequential target is not a one-normalizer static exponential tilt on \(\mathcal P_T\): at \(T=2\), with constant covariates, fair \(A_1\), deterministic \(A_2=A_1\), \(Y=A_2\), and \(c=\sqrt2\log(3/2)\), the sequential functional equals \(3/5\), whereas tilting the observed law once by \(\delta^{A_1+A_2}\) and globally normalizing yields \(9/13\).
body.justification: The counterexample blocks a tempting flattening that would erase the nested-prefix learning problem.
body.gap: SchindlShenKennedy2024 and HuangDongLinAntonelli2026 analyze static single-normalizer tilts; their target algebra cannot be substituted for the sequential functional.
body.consumer: The lower-bound and estimator proofs must preserve the original longitudinal intervention rather than import a static rate verbatim.
